# Metadata extractor fixture corpus

Synthetic, deterministic JPEG fixtures generated by [generate.py](generate.py).

## Why synthetic instead of real photos

- **Reproducibility** — every byte is deterministic; CI never surprises.
- **License clarity** — no third-party photo whose copyright I'd need to vet.
- **Small** — corpus stays under 10 KB; clones don't pay.
- **Targeted** — each fixture exercises ONE codepath; failures point at root cause.

The downside is we don't cover real-camera quirks (Canon's null-padded strings, Nikon's vendor MakerNote bloat, Sony's UTF-8 Artist field). Those are tracked as a separate follow-up "real-camera fixture corpus" issue; the synthetic corpus is the regression backstop for the core extraction logic.

## Fixtures

| File | EXIF state | Expected extractor result |
|---|---|---|
| `with_full_exif.jpg` | DateTime + DateTimeOriginal + DateTimeDigitized + Make=Canon + Model=Canon EOS R5 + Artist + ImageDescription + FNumber + ISO + FocalLength + LensModel | All canonical fields populated; orientation=1 |
| `orientation_1.jpg` | Orientation tag = 1 (normal) | `Orientation` = 1 |
| `orientation_6.jpg` | Orientation tag = 6 (90° CW) | `Orientation` = 6 |
| `orientation_8.jpg` | Orientation tag = 8 (90° CCW) | `Orientation` = 8 |
| `with_gps.jpg` | GPS lat/lon = SF Ferry Building (37.7955°N, 122.3937°W) | `FieldGPSCoordinates` ≈ (37.7955, -122.3937) |
| `no_metadata.jpg` | No EXIF segment | `ErrNoMetadata` |
| `unicode_artist.jpg` | Artist = "山田太郎" (kanji) | UTF-8 round-trip, validator passes |
| `future_date.jpg` | DateTimeOriginal = 3000-01-01 | Extractor returns value; validator rejects (future) |
| `gps_boundary.jpg` | GPS = (89.999°N, 179.999°E) | Validator accepts (boundary inclusive) |
| `malformed_truncated.jpg` | First half of a real JPEG | `ErrMalformedFile` (no panic) |

## Regenerating

```bash
pip install Pillow piexif
python3 generate.py
```

`generate.py` is deterministic — re-running must produce byte-identical output. If you change EXIF state (add a field, switch a tag value), update both `generate.py` AND the corresponding Go test assertion in `../exif/extractor_test.go`.

## Out of scope (deferred)

- HEIC / HEIF fixtures — extractor returns `ErrUnsupportedFormat` per Phase 1.18.A-2 brief (no CGo). A follow-up "aa-libheif add-on" capability package will land HEIC support; its fixture corpus lives with that package.
- IPTC / XMP fixtures — Phase 1.18.A-3.
- Raw camera files (CR2 / NEF / ARW / DNG) — Phase 1.18.A-3.
- PDF metadata — Phase 1.18.A-4.
- Real-camera quirk corpus — separate follow-up issue.
- Very large (4K+) fixtures — performance test territory; tracked separately if regressions surface.
